text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's been hours since arriving at this
mystery location with Gold Ship.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Whooshhh...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ahhhh,
I feel reborn... The sweet hydration
is spreading through my
whole body...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Has me thinking... Y'know when dried
seaweed is rehydrated? I
wonder if it feels
just like this...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
For some reason, we're just relaxing here,
sipping on the juice from
the coconut Gold
Ship split with her bare hands.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The sound of the waves, together with the
sweet coconut water, really
helps with my
fatigue.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's kind of strange,
but I feel like I could
do this forever...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Heh...
Looks like you're finally starting to
loosen up.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ain't this great? Sometimes you just gotta
take the time to do nothing
at all.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Sure, when I need to. They do say every
warrior has their resting
place.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Warrior in this case being a figure of
speech for an Umamusume racer.
Or if you
wanna be real slick, I used a "metaphor."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
And how do I put this... There's no place
hotter than a racetrack.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Even normally quiet Umamusume show
their true natures during a
race.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Everyone gives it their all,
and that's when
I can really let loose. I feel
my body burn
so hot that I get this huge relief from
it.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yup, even if you made me choose between
racing and catching toads,
I'd choose
racing every time.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
And this place... I can really relax here,
yup...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Whooshhh...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
That sound of the waves crashing... Hear
it? That's the real beauty of
nature...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Whooshhh...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ahh... So therapeutic... Spending my life
here wouldn't be bad at all...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Ahhhh...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Aaahhh...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: AAAAGHHH!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hoooly smokes! I finally feel it—the burnin' frustration!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
When you dance away from the pressure
of the race and spend too
much time
restin'! The pent-up hunger to race!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
It's the impulse that drives us! The fire!
The
burning! The explosion!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
This is it!
This is the hunger that I've been
starving to get!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
What're you waiting for, Trainer?! We're
going home—right now!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Weren't you listening? We've done what
we came to do. Time to go
back!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Geez, can you get any slower? What are
you, a snail? From Planet of
the Snails?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
If I don't burn with hunger before a
race, I
won't get hot enough to
run!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Now though? It's perfect. I'm absolutely
dying to run!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Good thing too, my race is tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hm? Wait... I didn't tell ya?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Wow, sorry 'bout that. ☆ Turns out my
debut race is tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
You and the whole country'll be in tears
after you witness my dazzling
moves!
Woooo! I'm on fire!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
So, let's hit the road! And no, you can't
take the coconut! Dispose of
it properly in
the sand!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Now where's home... Not a clue, but that
way looks promising!
Coming? You better
keep up!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Just when I was starting to figure out this treasure hunt, it's time to go back... To be continued
